note: Development acceptance prompts, not a held-out benchmark. Supplied documents are working references, not verified current policy.

cases.question: ሰላም
cases.review: Natural greeting; no document fact required.

cases.question: አፖሎ ምንድን ነው
cases.review: Explain the digital account using the displayed evidence. No invented terms.

cases.question: ያለ ካርድ ከኤቲኤም ገንዘብ ማውጣት እችላለሁ
cases.review: Explain the supported cardless withdrawal option, not the withdrawal limit.

cases.question: ለአቢሲንያ የሞባይል ባንኪንግ ለመመዝገብ ምን ያስፈልገኛል
cases.review: Preserve the existing-account prerequisite and branch registration instruction.

cases.question: የኤቲኤም ካርዴ ቢጠፋብኝ ምን ማድረግ አለብኝ
cases.review: Explain the available blocking methods; never claim to have blocked the card. Check longer speech for omissions/repeats.

cases.question: አሁን በግል ሂሳቤ ውስጥ ስንት ገንዘብ አለ
cases.review: Cannot access a personal balance. Do not invent a balance or ask for PIN/OTP.

cases.question: ሽሮ እንዴት ይሠራል
cases.review: Explain that the bank documents do not answer this; do not give a recipe.

cases.question: እሺ በጣም አመሰግናለሁ
cases.review: Natural acknowledgment, no invented bank fact.

cases.question: የአፖሎ USSD ኮድ ስንት ነው
cases.review: Compare the exact code with the supplied source. Listen for correct symbols and digits; this is not a live-service verification.

cases.question: አዲስ የቁጠባ ሂሳብ መክፈት እፈልጋለሁ ምን ሰነዶች ማቅረብ አለብኝ እና መጀመሪያ ስንት ገንዘብ ማስገባት አለብኝ
cases.review: A difficult compound query: relevant evidence or explicit insufficient-evidence response. Do not combine different account types. Retrieval is not established for this case.
